Medium format 6x7 documentary architectural plate, high-angle southward perspective overlooking St Colme Street and Charlotte Square, Edinburgh. Static, empty carriageways surfaced in dark bitumen bordered by dressed whinstone kerbs and Caithness flagstone pavements, completely void of vehicles and people.
